build_armature: build a mock armature object with named bones and parent hierarchy for Blender testing
build_bone: build a mock bone with optional IK chain constraints and rotation limits for testing
build_rotation_constraint: build a mock rotation constraint with configurable lock and limit settings per axis
build_mesh_object: build a mock mesh object with optional mesh data and parent bone assignment
build_material: build a mock material definition with configurable color, metallic, and roughness properties
